cases.note: Roadmap 1c: the model's summary must cite the stored relationships it uses, verified in Go. On 2026-11-10 Qwen's summaries named the subject (owasp.org) in sentences citing www.owasp.org items; naming the question's subject is now allowed in any cited sentence.

planner_replies: owasp.org receives mail through mx1.pphosted.com and uses pdns1.ultradns.net as a name server [E1, E2]. owasp.org relies on FASTLY: www.owasp.org resolves to 151.101.1.1, which AutonomousSystem 54113 announces and whose registration names FASTLY [E6, E7, E8, E9]. cases.question: Which third-party vendors are used by owasp.org?
cases.note: The vendors lens from a domain: the organization behind a verification token (a verified_for relationship from the DNS-SD plugin), the mail senders its SPF record authorizes, and the SPF include and verification-like record nothing recognizes.

answer_contains: SPF includes no vendor entry recognizes (1): spf.acme-mailer.example

cases.question: Which organizations make up utica.edu's institution?
cases.note: The family answer kind: the institution's name variants, its IT department (a registration contact), an affiliate holding a network that serves the domain, and the other domains that network serves; a provider and a similarly named company are not family.

cases.question: Who owns Utica Products USA Inc.?
cases.note: The org_group answer kind: the climb to the ultimate parent through stored subsidiary relationships (as GLEIF records them) and the organizations below it, including a reviewed unit; a company that only shares a name word is not in the group.

answer_contains: Ultimate parent: Utica Products Holdings S.A.

cases.question: What services does owasp.org expose, and what software do they run?
cases.note: The services answer kind: services stored by the probes for the domain's names, the software identified from a stored server header (with the fingerprint's source), and what stands out: an SSH service on an unusual port with a self-issued certificate.

cases.question: Which vendors do OWASP Foundation and the rest of its corporate group depend on?
cases.note: The group_vendors answer kind: each group organization scanned on its own, a registrar both colleges use counted once per college, and a group organization acting as a contact for another set apart from outside vendors.
